bullets: Nvidia reports after the close (first since Jensen Huang's CEO exit) and Anthropic IPO lands; new US chip-export curbs on China pressure AI/semis names.

RVTY.why: Q3 beat and guidance was raised; TD Cowen upgraded to Buy, JPM raised PT twice. Drop tracks an AI-fear-driven selloff across life-science-tools/diagnostics names that Barclays calls overdone, not company damage.
RVTY.bull: Earnings beat, raised guidance, and rising price targets suggest the sector selloff is an overreaction.
RVTY.bear: Stock trades at ~66x P/E vs 36x historical median, and insiders have only sold, not bought.

GPN.why: GPN fell ~12% on Nov 12 after CD&R and GTCR abandoned ~$40B take-private talks amid tight LBO financing conditions. The drop is idiosyncratic loss of a buyout premium, not sector/macro fear, so there's no mean-reversion edge.
GPN.bull: Shares may be reasonable even without a deal, and talks could resume or a new bidder could emerge.
GPN.bear: Giving back a takeover premium reflects a re-rating of standalone value, not an overreaction to fear.
GPN.catalysts: watch for M&A headline updates; no scheduled earnings in window

JHX.why: JHX fell ~8% after guiding Q3 and FY2027 revenue well below consensus on weak new-home construction and higher freight costs; Truist and others cut price targets. This is a company-specific guidance cut, not a sector-wide move.
JHX.bull: Strong Q3 earnings and upcoming S&P MidCap 400 inclusion support index-driven buying despite weak guidance.
JHX.bear: Guidance cut on housing weakness plus multiple price-target cuts point to a real demand slowdown.

BRKR.bull: EPS beat consensus and Leerink raised its price target to $85, calling bookings strong.
BRKR.bear: A $175M goodwill impairment and a fresh downgrade signal real trouble in the Spatial Biology unit.

UAL.why: Most of the drop traces to the Nov 13 FAA nationwide ground stop (aging ATC infrastructure) that hit AAL, DAL, LUV, JBLU and UAL alike, a $345M industry-wide hit per Bernstein. But UAL had its own separate outage Nov 16-17, adding company-specific operational risk.
UAL.bull: The FAA ground stop was an industry-wide infrastructure failure, not UAL-specific, so the bounce thesis holds.
UAL.bear: A second, UAL-only tech outage right after the FAA event raises doubt about company-specific systems risk.
UAL.catalysts: Thanksgiving travel surge begins ~Nov 20; risk of further ATC/tech disruptions in the hold window

CVNA.why: Q3 showed record volume/revenue but profit-per-vehicle fell ~10% y/y and Zacks cut 2026 EPS estimates; guidance was maintained, not cut. Mixed: a real margin-quality concern specific to CVNA, not a sector-wide drop, but no formal guidance cut or miss.
CVNA.bull: Record Q3 volume and maintained full-year EBITDA guidance suggest the margin worry is overblown.
CVNA.bear: Falling profit-per-car and cut EPS estimates on an already ~31x-earnings stock argue for further de-rating.

GM.bull: Earnings beat and analysts say buy the dip, with the selloff tied to shared industry commodity costs, not GM-specific failure.
GM.bear: Narrowed outlook and EV demand decline are real and could keep weighing on shares into year-end.

PHM.why: PHM missed Q3 2026 on both revenue ($3.97B vs $4.24B consensus) and EPS ($2.53 vs $2.63), dropping 7% on the report; Morgan Stanley downgraded to Equal-Weight on Nov 3. This is a company-specific earnings miss and fundamentals downgrade.
PHM.bull: Shares are up 13% over the past month even after the miss, suggesting bad news is priced in.
PHM.bear: Revenue and EPS miss plus a downgrade reflect genuine housing-demand softness, not just sentiment.
